crst_stations.tooltip_modspec: Stations are fitted by Station Yard Inc. at any showroom with working heavy industry.
crst_stations.ui_automated_ship: Automated ship. Station Yard Inc. regrets it cannot serve customers with no crew to pamper.
crst_stations.ui_cap_reason: Level %s max here: Platinum fittings need a showroom with Orbital Works or a nanoforge.
crst_stations.ui_footer_crew: Each Station level adds %s%% skeleton and max crew. Returns: %s%% of credits, no questions asked. Some questions asked.
crst_stations.ui_footer_sources: Materials come from your cargo, then your storage here, then our open market at very fair prices.
crst_stations.ui_picker_sub: For %s - slot %s of %s - %s showroom, up to level %s
crst_stations.ui_drawer_no_materials: Materials are non-refundable (contract clause 7b). Our condolences.
crst_stations.desc_shield: Shield technicians who massage every emitter by hand.
crst_stations.desc_logistics: Quartermasters who count every ration. Twice.
crst_stations.desc_engine: Drive crews who treat the speed limit as a suggestion.
crst_stations.desc_ballistic: Loaders so fast the autoloader filed a complaint.
crst_stations.desc_missile: Hand-loaded racks. Each missile signed by its loader.
crst_stations.desc_phase: Phase techs who mostly stay in this dimension.
crst_stations.desc_reactor: Reactor crews who run the core hot. Ventilation sold separately.
crst_stations.desc_damage_control: Welders on call, mid-battle. Hazard pay included.
crst_stations.desc_flight_deck: Deck crews who turn fighters around before the pilot finishes their coffee.
crst_stations.ui_taglines: Crew comfort is a weapon system.|Serving the Sector since before the Collapse. Probably.|Every Station fitted by people who read the manual.|Now 25% less likely to vent into space.|You break it, you bought it. Also if you didn't.|Financing not available in your sector.|Satisfaction guaranteed or your crew back.
crst_stations.desc_simulator: As an exceptional pilot, you stream your combat exploits to boost crew morale. No one has to know it was a simulation.
crst_stations.unlock_sts_first_win: Win a Slay the Sector Run
crst_stations.unlock_sts_missing: Needs the Slay the Sector mod
crst_stations.intel_bullet: Now in The Catalogue at any showroom
crst_stations.intel_capital_kill: Customer Relations has followed your recent, ahem, decommissioning of a capital ship with great interest. A captain of your calibre deserves our Missile Silo: hand-loaded racks, each missile signed by its loader. It is now in The Catalogue.
crst_stations.intel_credits: Our accountants noticed your balance and fainted. Once revived, they opened our Phase Station to you, reserved for clients of means. It is now in The Catalogue.
crst_stations.intel_fuel: With that much fuel aboard, you clearly intend to go places. May we suggest our Engine Station, for captains who treat the speed limit as a suggestion? It is now in The Catalogue.
crst_stations.intel_sts_first_win: Word of your triumph in the Descent has reached us. Exploits like yours deserve an audience: the Simulator Bay, for streaming them to a grateful crew, is now in The Catalogue.
